text.arabic_uthmani: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍۢ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةًۭ فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

words.gloss_range: interrogative-and-inferential opener that turns prior discourse into a demanded judgment on the case now shown
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) opens with question and inference together, so the listener is pressed to judge a case that follows from prior discourse rather than to satisfy neutral curiosity. It also begins a diagnostic frame: the ayah narrows from cosmic accounting into one portrait whose failed faculties will test the addressee’s own perception.

topics.headline: question plus inferential link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin as a compelled act of judgment, not an isolated request for information.
topics.reason: The aligned particle bundle is an interrogative opener with a discourse connector, and the CRITICAL rows coherently press both question and inference.

topics.headline: single case framed for diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the individual profile as a focused diagnostic portrait inside the wider justice frame.
topics.reason: The opening particle leads into the seeing question, while the boundary row links the focused case to the preceding created-and-recompensed horizon.

words.gloss_range: seeing as cognitive inspection and judgment, addressed to the listener before the ayah displays covered sight
words.root_gloss_range: range of seeing, perceiving, considering, and judging; the local form selects addressed cognitive inspection
words.prose: {{ar:رَءَيْتَ}} ({{tr:raʾayta}}) makes the addressee inspect and judge the person introduced next. The root {{ar:ر أ ي}} ({{tr:r-ʾ-y}}) keeps sight and consideration together, so the listener’s act of discernment becomes the counter-image to the covered sight reported later. The same desire-as-deity seeing formula appears in 25:43, while 45:23 intensifies it with sealing and the no-guide question. Variant and sound rows sharpen the recitational pressure without changing the local command to perceive.

topics.headline: seeing governs the inspected person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole desire-deifying profile becomes the grammatical object of inspection.
topics.reason: The perfect second-person verb governs the following relative pronoun as the object under consideration.

topics.headline: visual judgment field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening perception command answer the later image of covered sight.
topics.reason: The local root range supports cognitive seeing, and the ayah later marks the subject’s sight as covered.

topics.headline: hamza and variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a pressure point in the seeing command while keeping the same local perception sense.
topics.reason: Variant and sound rows illuminate recitation texture, but they do not replace the aligned local surface or create a new lexical sense.

topics.headline: desire-as-deity seeing formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the same desire-as-deity seeing formula in 25:43, with 45:23 adding sealing and the no-guide question.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the concrete parallel at 25:43 and describe how this ayah intensifies the formula.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun for the inspected person, both object of consideration and reusable moral type
words.prose: {{ar:مَنِ}} ({{tr:mani}}) is not merely a placeholder. It is the person seen by the addressee and the head of the clause that defines him by taking desire as authority, while its generic reach lets one unnamed case become a repeatable moral pattern.

topics.headline: object plus relative head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the inspected person is grammatically defined by the following act, not by a name or biography.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is governed by the seeing verb and heads the clause that identifies the person.

topics.headline: unnamed reusable type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the portrait as a portable diagnostic type rather than a closed historical anecdote.
topics.reason: The pronoun can present an unnamed rational agent, and the CRITICAL rows press that generic force without contradicting local grammar.

words.gloss_range: self-involving taking-as construction: adopting something as ruling authority, not merely possessing it
words.root_gloss_range: range of taking, grasping, acquiring, and adopting; the local Form VIII construction selects invested adoption as authority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّخَذَ}} ({{tr:ittakhadha}}) licenses the take-as frame in which deity-label and desire collapse into identification. The root {{ar:أ خ ذ}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-dh}}) contributes grasping and adoption pressure, while Form VIII makes the act self-involving: false authority is taken up, not stumbled into. The formula recurs in 25:43, but here the word also stands before the divine judgment chain, so human installation precedes judicial closure.

topics.headline: two-object adopted authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees syntax itself identify desire as the adopted deity rather than placing two ideas side by side.
topics.reason: The Form VIII verb takes two complements in a make-or-take-as construction.

topics.headline: taking becomes allegiance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels false worship as invested self-adoption of authority, not a passive feeling.
topics.reason: The root and Form VIII evidence support adoption for oneself within the locally licensed construction.

topics.headline: formula before judgment chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 45:23 intensify the desire-deity formula and place human adoption before divine closure.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the 25:43 parallel and the local sequence before misguidance, sealing, and covering; the sound note reinforces the same Form VIII act.

words.gloss_range: possessed deity-label: a privatized final authority brought into worship-language and answered by the true divine name
words.root_gloss_range: deity and worship-authority range, with derivational pressure around devotion and attachment; locally a possessed deity-label in a false-authority construction
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَٰهَهُۥ}} ({{tr:ilāhahu}}) makes the deity-label possessed: the authority is his, exposing a privatized object of ultimate obedience. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) keeps worship-authority in view, while the derivational dispute adds attachment pressure without displacing the local deity sense. Variants and the 25:43 echo preserve the charge that desire has entered deity-language, and later divine-name occurrences answer this manufactured authority.

topics.headline: private deity-label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the false authority is possessively personalized and then identified with desire.
topics.reason: The noun carries a third-person suffix and sits as a complement beside the desire noun in the take-as construction.

topics.headline: deity sense with attachment pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the word as worship-authority while still feeling the pressure of bewildered attachment around desire.
topics.reason: The local noun means deity or worshiped authority; derivational dispute can color the possessed label but should not replace the selected sense.

topics.headline: variant object shapes and 25:43 echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that variant shapes and 25:43 keep the same core accusation: desire is pulled into deity-language.
topics.reason: The variants reshape the object form, while 25:43 supplies the concrete desire-deity recurrence; neither overrides the canonical local surface.

topics.headline: made deity answered by true agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks an authority contrast from possessed deity-label to true divine agency and boundary.
topics.reason: The ayah later names God as actor and final boundary, answering the possessed false authority.

words.gloss_range: possessed desire as the installed authority, with downward-pull and captivation pressure locally narrowed to appetite made sovereign
words.root_gloss_range: desire, inclination, falling, and being drawn down; locally possessed appetite installed as authority, not a neutral preference
words.prose: {{ar:هَوَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:hawāhu}}) completes the take-as construction: the adopted authority is his own desire. The root {{ar:ه و ي}} ({{tr:h-w-y}}) lets desire carry downward pull and captivation pressure, while the suffix and singular form make the enthroned authority personal rather than abstract. Against the plural desire-warning in 45:18 and guidance contrasts in 28:50 and 38:26, this singular possessed desire is enthroned before guidance is queried. Its position at the beat’s end makes desire the hinge before God becomes the explicit actor, and its nearness to knowledge shows informed misalignment, not mere ignorance.

topics.headline: desire identifies the adopted deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees desire grammatically occupy the identity slot of the adopted deity.
topics.reason: The noun with suffix completes the second complement of the take-as construction.

topics.headline: desire with fall and capture pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels appetite as a downward and capturing sovereignty, while the local noun remains desire.
topics.reason: The root family supports falling and drawing pressure, but local grammar selects the possessed desire noun in the deity slot.

topics.headline: singular desire against warning field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this enthroned singular desire with warnings against desire-following in 45:18, 28:50, and 38:26.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references and preserve a local contrast between desire and guidance.

topics.headline: desire before judgment and beside knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices desire as the hinge into divine judgment and as a force standing beside knowledge.
topics.reason: The word closes the first unit before the divine-action chain, and knowledge appears immediately in the next movement.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that binds human adoption to the following divine judgment without isolating the clauses
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the self-deification clause to the divine misguidance clause. Its force can be additive or circumstantial, so the ayah keeps human adoption and divine judgment tightly connected without requiring a simplistic time gap.

topics.headline: human act tied to divine consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the pivot from chosen false authority into divine judgment as one connected movement.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the relative clause to the divine-action sequence and permits close coordination or circumstance.

words.gloss_range: causative misguidance directed at the same desire-deifier; path-loss becomes an effected judicial condition
words.root_gloss_range: wandering, error, loss, and causing to stray; locally Form IV makes path-loss an effected state
words.prose: {{ar:أَضَلَّهُ}} ({{tr:aḍallahu}}) sends the action back to the same person who installed desire as authority. The root {{ar:ض ل ل}} ({{tr:ḍ-l-l}}) makes the judgment feel like route-loss, and Form IV makes that loss an effected condition rather than accidental wandering. This first explicit divine action begins the closure chain and sets up the later guidance verb as the denied reversal, localizing the no-guide formula of 7:186 in the desire-deifier’s case.

topics.headline: misguidance returns to the desire-deifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same person from self-authorized desire into the object of divine misguidance.
topics.reason: The object suffix returns to the relative pronoun that heads the desire-deifying clause.

topics.headline: judicial route-loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels punishment as path-loss made operative by divine action.
topics.reason: The Form IV verb is causative from a root field of wandering, error, and loss.

topics.headline: misguidance sets up no guide
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine misguidance open the sequence that the later guide-question cannot undo, with 7:186 as a concrete formulaic parallel.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the local verb to 7:186 and to the later guidance verb within the same ayah.

words.gloss_range: explicit nominative divine name that fixes the agent of misguidance, sealing, and covering
words.root_gloss_range: deity and worship-authority range; as the proper divine name it identifies true divine agency, not a generic authority
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) names the agent even though the verb already implies a subject, removing ambiguity about who governs the closure chain. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) is now not a false authority label but the proper divine name: the one displaced by desire acts as judge, brings the sealing field known from 2:7 into this desire case, and continues through misguidance, sealing, and covering before becoming the final boundary. The same divine agency also carries forward the creation-and-judgment frame of 45:22.

topics.headline: named subject of closure chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one named divine subject unify route-loss, sealing, and covering.
topics.reason: The proper noun is explicit after the verb and remains the understood subject of the coordinated perfect verbs.

topics.headline: proper name refuses abstraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not reduce closure to psychology or fate; it is attributed to the named God.
topics.reason: The aligned word is the divine proper noun and later reappears in a different case as boundary.

topics.headline: true actor against false deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the contest between the possessed deity-label and true divine agency, with the sealing field echoed in 2:7.
topics.reason: The rows give the 2:7 echo, the false-authority contrast, and continuity from the preceding creation-and-judgment frame.

words.gloss_range: preposition attaching knowledge to the misguidance phrase, allowing basis, state, and adverse-overlay force
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) begins the knowledge phrase immediately after misguidance. It can point to ground, state, or adverse overlay, so either way the ayah severs knowledge from automatic rescue: knowledge becomes the first surface over which the judgment is read.

topics.headline: knowledge attached to misguidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge is brought directly into the misguidance phrase instead of being left outside the diagnosis.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase follows the misguidance verb and can attach to divine action or to the person’s state.

topics.headline: basis or despite force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both basis and adverse-pressure readings in view while not making either erase the other.
topics.reason: The preposition supports basis and overlay values; local ambiguity should be preserved rather than forced into one paraphrase.

words.gloss_range: indefinite knowledge as a present condition that does not protect against desire-governed misguidance
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, knowledge, marking, and recognized condition; locally an indefinite state or basis within the misguidance phrase
words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿilmin}}) is indefinite, so the phrase can hold known evidence, a state of knowledge, or a known condition without turning knowledge into salvation. The root {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) names cognition that is present but no longer governing desire; 28:50 shows desire without divine guidance, while 45:24 later exposes knowledge-absence in human claims. Here the first overlay layer is knowledge before the ayah moves to sealed hearing-heart and covered sight.

topics.headline: indefinite knowledge condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not reduce the case to ignorance; some form of knowledge is present as a condition.
topics.reason: The indefinite verbal noun after the preposition presents knowledge as an open condition rather than a finite saving act.

topics.headline: information does not save desire-governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees cognition survive but fail to govern appetite within a justice frame.
topics.reason: The knowledge phrase follows desire and misguidance, and the boundary evidence keeps judgment from sounding arbitrary.

topics.headline: knowledge and desire contrasts elsewhere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects 45:23 with 28:50 and 45:24: desire can coexist with knowledge, and later claims can still lack knowledge.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete references and compare the local use to desire and knowledge contrasts.

topics.headline: knowledge as first surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge as the first layer before heavier images of faculty closure.
topics.reason: The phrase is the first of the repeated overlay constructions before hearing-heart and sight.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that continues the completed divine-action chain into faculty sealing
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates sealing with the completed misguidance act. The connector adds another divine action rather than explaining the previous one away, keeping one subject moving through a staged chain from path-loss into faculty closure.

topics.headline: coordination of divine perfects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows misguidance and sealing as accumulated divine acts within one completed sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction continues the coordinated perfect chain under the same divine subject.

words.gloss_range: sealing upon hearing and heart: authoritative closure imposed over faculties before the sight covering
words.root_gloss_range: sealing, closing, stamping, and finalizing; locally an authoritative completed closure upon faculties
words.prose: {{ar:خَتَمَ}} ({{tr:khatama}}) seals upon hearing and heart, so closure is imposed over faculties rather than described as mere weakness inside them. The root {{ar:خ ت م}} ({{tr:kh-t-m}}) brings finalizing mark and closure together, and the known sealing-faculty field in 2:7 and 6:46 is locally reworked after desire and knowledge. The verb also differs from the later placement of a visual veil, preserving distinct impairment mechanisms.

topics.headline: closure imposed over faculties
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures an authoritative seal over hearing and heart, not a vague inner weakness.
topics.reason: The verb governs an overlay phrase over the faculties, and the root supports sealing and final closure.

topics.headline: known faculty-sealing field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the marked sealing verb as part of a known closure field, especially 2:7 and 6:46.
topics.reason: The concrete references and rarity rows preserve the markedness of this perfect verb.

topics.headline: seal differs from visual cover
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reception and inward processing closed by a seal before sight receives a different visual obstruction.
topics.reason: The local sequence assigns sealing to hearing-heart and a placed veil to sight.

topics.headline: closure sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a compact closure texture at the very verb of sealing.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local and supports the sealing action without adding a separate lexical branch.

words.gloss_range: shared overlay preposition governing hearing and heart under one seal and continuing the ayah’s layered surface pattern
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) governs both hearing and heart under the same seal. It repeats the overlay logic that first touched knowledge and will later become spatially vivid over sight, turning the faculties into successive surfaces under divine action.

topics.headline: one preposition over hearing and heart
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearing and heart bound under one sealed-over phrase.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the first faculty and extends through coordination to the second.

topics.headline: overlay pattern advances
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah building a layered surface pattern from knowledge to faculties to sight.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition creates a sequence of imposed surfaces in the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: hearing as the sealed domain of reception and heeding, not merely acoustic capacity
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, accepting, and responsive reception; locally the sealed domain of heeding
words.prose: {{ar:سَمْعِهِۦ}} ({{tr:samʿihi}}) is the first sealed domain under the overlay phrase. The root {{ar:س م ع}} ({{tr:s-m-ʿ}}) includes heeding and responsive reception, so the seal blocks more than sound entering the ear. With 2:7 in the background, its placement before heart makes failed reception precede failed inward processing, while sight later receives a different impairment.

topics.headline: hearing governed under the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees hearing as the domain sealed over, not the direct object of the verb.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the overlay preposition.

topics.headline: hearing as heeding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the loss as blocked reception and obedience, not only reduced acoustics.
topics.reason: The root range includes listening, accepting, and responsive reception.

topics.headline: reception before heart and sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the faculty sequence: hearing first, heart next, sight separately covered, with 2:7 in the background.
topics.reason: The rows give the 2:7 echo, local order, distinct hearing-sight impairments, and sound texture tied to blocked reception.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that keeps heart under the same sealed-over phrase with hearing
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps heart inside the same governed phrase as hearing. One seal covers the paired faculties, while the later sight phrase receives its own verb, location, and object.

topics.headline: heart coordinated under same seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices hearing and heart as one sealed pair before sight is treated separately.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the heart into the same overlay phrase rather than launching a new verb.

words.gloss_range: heart as the sealed center of inward orientation and possible reorientation, paired with hearing before sight is covered
words.root_gloss_range: turning, reversal, inner orientation, and heart; locally the inward faculty locked against reorientation
words.prose: {{ar:قَلْبِهِۦ}} ({{tr:qalbihi}}) shares the sealed-over phrase with hearing, making inward orientation part of the same closure. The root {{ar:ق ل ب}} ({{tr:q-l-b}}) carries turning and reversal pressure, so the sealed heart is the very faculty that might have turned back now locked against reorientation. Unlike the heart-then-hearing order in 2:7, the order here moves from hearing to heart to covered sight, staging failed reception, failed inward response, and failed discernment.

topics.headline: heart bound under same seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heart sealed with hearing rather than treated as an unrelated faculty.
topics.reason: The noun is coordinated into the same governed overlay phrase as hearing.

topics.headline: heart as blocked reorientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the loss as blocked reorientation: the turning faculty cannot turn back.
topics.reason: The root range supports turning and reversal pressure, while local grammar keeps the noun as heart.

topics.headline: hearing-heart before visual veil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the staged movement from reception into inward response before visual occlusion, with 2:7 as a contrasting order.
topics.reason: The rows preserve the order shift from 2:7, the local sequence, and the heart-and-seal closure field.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that continues the divine subject while adding a distinct placement act
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) continues the same divine subject while adding a different act. It prevents sealing and placing from collapsing into one mechanism: after sealed hearing-heart comes an installed obscuring layer over sight.

topics.headline: same subject, new impairment mechanism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sight-covering as a further divine act, not a natural accident or a duplicate of sealing.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates a new perfect verb under the same understood divine subject.

words.gloss_range: placing or making with a located object; here narrowed toward concrete placement of a covering over sight
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, appointing, rendering, and setting; locally narrowed by the overlay phrase toward placing a covering
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) combines a placed object with a location over sight. The root {{ar:ج ع ل}} ({{tr:j-ʿ-l}}) can range across making, placing, and appointing, but the local overlay phrase narrows it toward concrete placement of the veil. Its perfect form presents the visual obstruction as accomplished before the guide-question, and its wider faculty-giving distribution is reversed here into sight-obstruction: 45:18 places the Prophet on a way, while 45:23 places a covering over sight, with 6:25 as another covering scene.

topics.headline: object plus location over sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the veil as something placed on a marked faculty-domain, not an abstract rendering.
topics.reason: The verb takes the covering as object and an overlay phrase locating it on sight.

topics.headline: perfect placement before guide question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader enters the guide-question after visual obstruction is already presented as accomplished.
topics.reason: The perfect verb marks the placement as completed within the closure sequence.

topics.headline: wider faculty field narrowed to sight covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a reversal of faculty-giving language: here the verb places obstruction, especially against the guided placement of 45:18 and the covering scene of 6:25.
topics.reason: The wider distribution with faculties is relevant, but local grammar reserves this verb for placing a veil on sight while other faculties are sealed.

topics.headline: placement parallels sealing with distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps two impairment mechanisms distinct: sealing for hearing-heart and veil-placement for sight.
topics.reason: The local verbs differ and govern different faculty domains.

words.gloss_range: spatial overlay preposition locating the covering specifically on sight and completing the surface progression
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) now becomes spatially vivid: the covering is on sight. This third overlay completes the progression from knowledge, to sealed hearing-heart, to covered vision.

topics.headline: exact surface of the veil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates the obstruction precisely on sight and discernment.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the sight noun as the domain of the placed covering.

topics.headline: overlay progression completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the repeated overlay architecture reach its most concrete image.
topics.reason: This is the third local overlay phrase after knowledge and hearing-heart.

words.gloss_range: sight and discernment as the final faculty-domain, covered rather than sealed
words.root_gloss_range: sight, perception, and insight; locally the covered faculty of visual and evaluative discernment
words.prose: {{ar:بَصَرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:baṣarihi}}) is not sealed by the earlier verb; it is the domain on which the veil is placed. The root {{ar:ب ص ر}} ({{tr:b-ṣ-r}}) includes sight and discernment, so the covering impairs evaluative insight as well as seeing. It is the final faculty in the impairment triad, echoes the sight-covering pairing of 2:7, and answers the opening command to inspect: the listener must see while the subject’s sight is covered.

topics.headline: sight under placed veil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes sight’s impairment from the earlier seal over hearing and heart.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the overlay preposition attached to the placement verb, not by the sealing verb.

topics.headline: discernment covered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the covering as blocking evaluative insight, not only ordinary vision.
topics.reason: The root range supports both visual perception and discernment.

topics.headline: final faculty with exact veil echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks sight as the final faculty-domain, with the veil-sight pairing echoed in 2:7.
topics.reason: The rows give the 2:7 echo and the local movement through route, reception, inward processing, and vision.

topics.headline: audience discernment versus covered sight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees offered perception turned into occlusion in the subject, making the audience’s discernment the counter-image.
topics.reason: The opening seeing verb and the boundary note about offered insights support the local contrast.

words.gloss_range: indefinite placed covering over sight; a concrete veil image with variant-sensitive covering and dimness pressure
words.root_gloss_range: covering, veiling, enveloping, and dimness-related pressure; locally the placed veil over sight
words.prose: {{ar:غِشَٰوَةًۭ}} ({{tr:ghishāwatan}}) is the indefinite object placed over sight. The root {{ar:غ ش و}} ({{tr:gh-sh-w}}) gives external covering, while variant evidence can shade the image toward dimness without replacing the canonical veil. The noun closes the faculty-impairment chain, echoes the sight-covering in 2:7, and makes the repeated overlay pattern visible as an actual covering.

topics.headline: unspecified but total covering object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the obstruction as a placed object whose material is unspecified but whose effect completes the chain.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite accusative as the object of the placement verb.

topics.headline: covering field with variant dimness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both external covering and dimness pressure in view while the local surface remains a covering noun.
topics.reason: Variant noun patterns illuminate the covering field and possible dimness pressure, but they do not govern the canonical parse.

topics.headline: 2:7 veil-sight echo and marked noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a precise veil-sight echo with 2:7, now followed by the no-guide question.
topics.reason: The concrete 2:7 echo and rarity row make the noun a marked chosen image for sight obstruction.

topics.headline: muffled endpoint of overlay architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final veil as the sounded and visible endpoint of the ayah’s overlay pattern.
topics.reason: The sound rows and synthesis rows gather the muffled texture, repeated overlay construction, variant sensitivity, and echo evidence.

words.gloss_range: consequence connector that turns the closure sequence into the resulting guide-question
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) converts the closure chain into a consequence-question. It supplies inference while the next word supplies the possible agent, so the guide-question follows from deified desire and closed faculties rather than opening a separate topic.

topics.headline: closure produces guide-question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats the search for a guide as the logical result of the diagnosis, not as a new aside.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the consequence-question after the closure sequence and precedes the interrogative subject.

words.gloss_range: interrogative subject asking what possible agent could guide, with negative rhetorical force after the divine boundary
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) is the subject of the guidance verb, asking which possible agent could guide the already-misguided person. After the divine boundary phrase, the question becomes a challenge to produce any valid guide, and the expected answer is none.

topics.headline: possible guide as grammatical subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the question search for an agent, not for an abstract possibility.
topics.reason: The interrogative pronoun functions as the subject of the following guidance verb.

topics.headline: agent search closes negatively
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the question as a challenge whose search-space will be closed after God.
topics.reason: The later boundary phrase gives the interrogative its negative rhetorical force.

words.gloss_range: guidance verb opening a possible restoration only to have every rival guide excluded after God
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, directing, and route-restoration; locally possible restoration under interrogation, bounded by God
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْدِيهِ}} ({{tr:yahdīhi}}) opens the possibility of guidance under interrogation, but the after-God phrase closes every rival guide. The root {{ar:ه د ي}} ({{tr:h-d-y}}) answers the earlier misguidance field as route-restoration, and the suffix keeps the same desire-deifier as the one for whom guidance is sought. The 7:186 no-guide formula becomes concrete here within desire, knowledge, sealing, and covering.

topics.headline: imperfect guidance under interrogation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a search for possible rescue open, then close at the divine boundary.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is governed by the interrogative frame and followed by the after-God boundary.

topics.headline: guidance answers misguidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees guidance as the denied reversal of divinely effected path-loss.
topics.reason: The guidance root answers the misguidance root within the same ayah.

topics.headline: suffix keeps the target constant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same person from desire-deifier to misguided object to proposed guidance target.
topics.reason: The object suffix refers back to the same masculine singular person.

topics.headline: 7:186 concretized in this portrait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the no-guide principle of 7:186 to this concrete anthropology of desire, knowledge, and closed faculties.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give 7:186 explicitly and explain how 45:23 localizes it.

words.gloss_range: separation/source preposition forming the after-God phrase and combining succession with exclusion
words.prose: {{ar:مِنۢ}} ({{tr:min}}) forms the after-God phrase with the following construct noun. It can carry succession and separation, so the question asks about guidance after God and apart from God, opening the search for a guide only to shut it at the divine boundary.

topics.headline: forms after-God construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary phrase is delayed until after the guide verb, so possibility opens before it closes.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the construct noun and comes after the guidance verb.

topics.headline: after and apart from force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the phrase exclude rival authority, not merely sequence events in time.
topics.reason: The preposition can mark separation as well as source or starting point in this construction.

words.gloss_range: construct afterness bound to God, making distance into an authority boundary after completed closure
words.root_gloss_range: after, beyond, distance, and separation; locally construct afterness made into a divine authority boundary
words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) is construct-bound to the divine name, so afterness does not float as a vague adverb. The root {{ar:ب ع د}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-d}}) gives distance and beyondness, but here that distance becomes an authority boundary: downstream from misguidance, sealing, and covering, no lower guide can override God. The same-surah after-God pressure from 45:6 shifts here from belief or discourse to guidance.

topics.headline: afterness bound to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the boundary syntactically fixed to God rather than left as general sequence.
topics.reason: The construct noun requires the following divine name as complement.

topics.headline: beyondness as authority limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears afterness as an impossibility of guidance beyond God, not only later time.
topics.reason: The local guide-question and divine complement make distance function as authority exclusion.

topics.headline: 45:6 after-God formula deepened
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the after-God formula in 45:6 with the guidance boundary in 45:23.
topics.reason: The rows give the same-surah reference and explain the shift from belief/discourse to guidance.

topics.headline: after completed closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the word arrive after the closure sequence, with its boundary phrase audibly tightened.
topics.reason: The word occurs after misguidance, sealing, and covering; the sound row supports the same boundary phrase.

words.gloss_range: genitive divine name completing the after-God boundary and ending the search for any guide
words.root_gloss_range: deity and worship-authority range; as the genitive proper divine name it completes the final boundary for guidance
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:llāhi}}) completes the after-God phrase as the genitive endpoint of the guidance search. The root {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) is not a false deity label here but the proper divine name that makes the boundary personal and divine. The after-God formula in 45:6 concerns belief after God and His signs; here in 45:23 it concerns guidance after God’s judgment. The ayah’s authority arc runs from his possessed deity-label, to God as actor, to God as final limit before the audience is addressed.

topics.headline: divine name completes boundary phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the guidance boundary as personal divine reference, not an abstract limit.
topics.reason: The proper noun is governed by the construct boundary noun and completes the phrase.

topics.headline: 45:6 formula shifts predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects 45:6 and 45:23 as progressive after-God finality, from belief to guidance.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete same-surah recurrence and distinguish the predicates.

topics.headline: false authority to true boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the arc from made authority, to true divine action, to final guidance limit.
topics.reason: The local divine/deity references form an authority arc and this occurrence closes the guide-question before the final admonition.

words.gloss_range: final interrogative-and-inferential opener that redirects the displayed case toward the audience’s response
words.prose: {{ar:أَفَ}} ({{tr:a-fa}}) opens the final question and scopes over the negated remembering verb. It mirrors the initial question, turning the displayed individual into an audience test: if this case has been made visible, will the listeners still fail to remember?

topics.headline: interrogates non-remembrance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final question redirect the case toward the audience’s own response.
topics.reason: The particle bundle precedes negation plus imperfect and introduces the final audience-directed question.

topics.headline: opening and closing questions mirror
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah bracketed by perception at the opening and remembrance at the close.
topics.reason: The second particle bundle mirrors the first while moving from singular seeing to plural remembering.

words.gloss_range: negating particle inside the final question, pressing ongoing non-remembrance rather than issuing a prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the indicative remembering verb inside the final question. It is not a direct prohibition; it presses the audience about ongoing failure, creating a pause before the memory verb and making non-remembrance itself the risk under interrogation.

topics.headline: negation without command force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a rebuke of ongoing failure rather than a ban on remembering.
topics.reason: The negative particle precedes an indicative imperfect in a rhetorical question, not a jussive prohibition.

topics.headline: non-remembrance as danger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the pause before remembrance as pressure: the audience could fail to respond to the warning.
topics.reason: The negation functions within the final interrogative frame and delays the key memory verb.

words.gloss_range: Form V audience remembrance: internalized admonitory uptake of the whole displayed case
words.root_gloss_range: mention, reminder, remembering, and taking heed; locally Form V internalized admonitory remembrance
words.prose: {{ar:تَذَكَّرُونَ}} ({{tr:tadhakkarūn}}) closes with plural audience uptake. Its object is unstated, so the whole displayed case becomes the reminder to internalize. The root {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) ranges beyond recall into admonitory heed, and Form V makes the warning something taken into oneself. Against the reminder command of 87:9, this ending asks whether the displayed case will become beneficial remembrance. The ayah widens from singular seeing to plural remembering, asking whether perception will become communal accountability.

topics.headline: unstated object makes case the reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the whole preceding portrait as what must be taken to heart.
topics.reason: No object is expressed for the verb, so the discourse supplies the object of remembrance.

topics.headline: remembrance as heed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ending demand usable warning, not bare recollection.
topics.reason: The root range includes remembering, mention, reminder, and taking heed.

topics.headline: Form V internalization with variant texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels remembrance as internalized uptake, while variant and sound details remain recitational texture rather than a different local sense.
topics.reason: Form V supports reflexive/internalized uptake; variant rows expose the morphology without replacing the canonical form.

topics.headline: 87:9 echo and singular-to-plural frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the beneficial reminder of 87:9 with this closing test, where one observed case becomes plural accountability.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete 87:9 echo and the local frame from singular seeing to plural remembering.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The acquisition-deity-desire chain at words 3-5, followed by deviation, blocked faculties, and the question of guidance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The acquisitive verb installs an inward inclination into the office of a worshipped authority. Desire is therefore not merely an appetite that wins once; it becomes the rule by which perception, judgment, and direction are accepted or refused.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the act by which desire is installed as a governing possession.
Worship and the object made worshipped supply the office transferred to desire, while the repeated divine name exposes the counterfeit.
The inward pull of appetite supplies the candidate authority that selects what the person will follow.
Departure from a right destination supplies the governing result of enthroned inclination.
Gentle direction toward the true road supplies the remedy whose source the closing question restricts.
Recovering what has slipped from active awareness supplies the final counter-operation to desire's rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns a person who happens to prefer appetite over an external command.
changed_reading.after: The verse diagnoses an act of inner enthronement: appetite is acquired as the authority that governs which evidence, judgment, and direction can count.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Knowledge at word 9 is followed by a seal on hearing and heart, a cover over sight, and an unanswered demand for a guide.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing can mean comprehension and compliance, the heart can be the faculty that turns an affair, sight can be inward discernment, and guidance supplies direction. The seal and cover therefore close a feedback circuit: information may exist, but it cannot become obedient understanding, inward reversal, or corrected movement.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies information already present inside the paradox of misdirection.
A secured preventive seal supplies closure rather than mere weakness of the affected channels.
Understanding, accepting, and acting on speech make hearing the input-to-obedience channel that is closed.
Turning something from one face to another supplies the heart's missing capacity to reconsider and reverse course.
Penetrating inward discernment makes the covered sight a loss of verification, not only optical vision.
An overlying cover supplies the obstruction that keeps discernment from reaching its object.
Direction, manner, and intended course supply the output that the closed circuit can no longer correct.

changed_reading.before: The sensory organs are listed as independently disabled faculties.
changed_reading.after: The list describes a closed reorientation system: disclosed information cannot pass through comprehension, inward turning, discernment, and finally corrected direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact construction joining misdirection with knowledge at words 6-9, framed by an opening demand to consider and a later question about direction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge may qualify the person's condition, the divine act, or both. A secondary branch also makes knowledge a distinguishing route-marker, so the construction can picture deviation occurring at a marked place rather than in an informational void. The focus wording does not force these possibilities into one owner or one causal order.

activation_trace.role: An attention-getting request to report or consider opens the verse as a case whose causal scope must be inspected.
Known disclosure keeps both knowledgeable agency and knowledge-defying conduct live.
A distinguishing sign or route-marker spatializes the paradox as deviation where guidance was visibly marked.
Missing the intended road supplies the event whose relation to knowledge remains deliberately tense.
A road, manner, or direction completes the marker-and-deviation geometry without settling who possessed knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is a flat concession meaning only that the person knew better.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is a live scope fork: the person may deviate knowingly, God may act knowingly, and the branch image permits deviation at the very marker of a known route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence presents visible signs being audibly received, persistence tightening like a knot, self-magnification, and then learned signs being acquired as ridicule. The focus seal now reads as the stabilized form of a repeated reception-refusal cycle, not as absence of exposure.

activation_trace.role: An outwardly evident sign supplies the content that is available rather than hidden.
Hearing as understanding and compliance sharpens the contrast between acoustic reception and refused uptake.
Tightening and knotting give persistence a self-fastening material shape.
Claimed greatness supplies the motive that keeps the knot from yielding to what was heard.
Actual learning supplies a second explicit stage of reception before rejection.
Acquiring something for one's own use supplies the active reassignment of learned signs into ridicule.
The secured seal names the resulting closure of a pattern repeatedly tightened by refusal.

structural_cues: In 45:8 the same hearing root appears before and after persistence, producing the explicit sequence heard -> persisted -> as if not heard.
In 45:9 learning precedes taking the signs as ridicule; 45:23 recombines learning, taking, hearing, and closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reception followed by persistence, pride, and reassignment; I infer that this sequence is the humanly enacted shape antecedent to the seal. A live alternative is that the divine seal remains an independent sovereign act whose temporal relation to those refusals is not specified.

changed_reading.before: The seal explains why the person never receives or understands evidence.
changed_reading.after: The seal is the hardened state of someone who receives, understands enough to react, and repeatedly converts evidence into a reason not to yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Alternation, directed turning from state to state, and eventual return make the surrounding world dynamically reversible. Against that field, sealing the heart's turning branch is the immobilization of the inner pivot needed to reconsider, reverse, and return.

activation_trace.role: Alternating succession supplies a world whose intelligibility depends on repeated changeover.
Turning something from one condition to another supplies the external analogue of inward reorientation.
Return to a prior point supplies the terminal movement that a fixed inner orientation resists.
The capacity to turn a matter onto another face makes the heart the inner pivot of revision.
A preventing seal supplies the lock that stops the pivot from changing orientation.

structural_cues: 45:5 moves through night/day alternation, rain, revival after death, and redirected winds; 45:15 ends with return.
The focus places the heart between hearing and sight, where an inner turn could have converted input into a changed course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external alternation, turning, return, and the heart's lexical capacity to turn; I assign the analogy that inward repentance requires the same pivoting operation. The live alternative is the ordinary faculty reading of heart without a dynamic systems analogy.

changed_reading.before: The heart is one more organ made unreceptive.
changed_reading.after: The heart is the locked pivot: in a world full of alternation and return, the person has lost the capacity to turn an affair onto a new face.

context_deltas.mechanism: What descends gives dead earth life, craft can flow under an ordering purpose, and the prescribed way is imaged as an exposed water access. The explicit contrast between following that course and following inclinations turns the focus failure into diversion from a supplied life-bearing route; the request for guidance asks who can restore direction once that diversion is sealed.

activation_trace.role: Delivery downward supplies the incoming life-bearing resource rather than a resource generated by the self.
Earth revived through rain and growth makes reception of the descending resource transformative.
Continuous flowing supplies purposeful movement along a medium rather than self-chosen drift.
A visible access point to water gives the prescribed course a life-supplying spatial image.
Following in sequence supplies adherence to one course and exposes the rival course selected by desire.
Inclinations supply the rival current explicitly prohibited as an object of following.
Direction and manner supply the course that must be restored after diversion.

structural_cues: The packet orders rain and revival in 45:5, purposeful flow in 45:12, and a prescribed course versus inclinations in 45:18 before the focus asks about guidance.
The focus moves from installed inclination to deviation and then closes the channels that could receive and navigate by the supplied course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, revival, flow, a visible water access, following, and inclination; I connect them as a water-navigation model for guidance. The live alternative is to keep each image local and read the prescribed course only in its legal-ethical sense.

changed_reading.before: The person simply chooses a bad rule instead of a good rule.
changed_reading.after: The person diverts from a supplied, life-bearing course into an inclination-led current, then loses the receptive and directional capacities by which the course could be regained.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly places divergent paths after knowledge and assigns transgressive rivalry as the separating force; it then opposes following a marked course to following inclinations. Public insight remains available, while each self acquires an outcome without withheld right. This strongly activates the focus as culpable post-knowledge divergence while leaving divine knowledgeable judgment as a live grammatical reading.

activation_trace.role: Each party taking a path unlike the other's supplies divergence as route selection rather than mere intellectual variety.
Knowledge arriving before division supplies the decisive post-knowledge ordering.
Crossing a limit through aggressive excess supplies the social force that converts knowledge into rival paths.
Tracking step after step supplies deliberate adherence, whether to the prescribed course or to rival inclinations.
Plural inclinations supply socially distributed rival selectors rather than one isolated appetite.
Publicly offered inward insights keep the evidence field available before the focus describes covered discernment.
Seeking and acquiring an outcome supplies personal participation in what is recompensed.
Withholding a due right is explicitly negated, constraining the recompense sequence by justice.
The route-marker branch condenses the context's available insight, diverging paths, and accountable acquisition into the focus phrase.

structural_cues: 45:17 states knowledge before divergence and rivalry; 45:18 immediately contrasts following the prescribed course with following inclinations.
45:20 offers insights and guidance, and 45:22 places individual acquisition inside recompense without injustice immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal order, rivalry, rival following, available insight, acquisition, and negated injustice; I infer a judicial progression from chosen divergence to hardened condition. The materially live alternative is that knowledge in the focus primarily qualifies God's act, while the context only describes the person's prior conduct.

changed_reading.before: Desire replaces guidance because the person lacks knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Desire can seize a post-knowledge situation, split a shared marker into rival paths, and make acquired divergence the setting of a justly described seal; divine knowledgeable agency remains a coexisting reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gives the focus abstraction a concrete intellectual form: extended time is assigned exclusive destructive agency even though the claim rests on conjecture rather than knowledge. Desire-as-deity thus includes preferred causal stories that satisfy the self, not only sensual appetite.

activation_trace.role: Falling into destruction supplies the ultimate effect attributed exclusively to the chosen causal agent.
Extended time supplies the impersonal process promoted into an exclusive disposer of life and death.
The explicit absence of disclosed knowledge marks the causal claim as unsupported.
Unstable supposition supplies the epistemic material from which the preferred world-model is built.
The office of a worshipped authority names the status effectively granted to the impersonal causal story.
Inclination supplies the preference that selects and protects the conjectural explanation.

structural_cues: 45:24 follows the focus immediately and assigns an exclusive causal verb to time before denying knowledge and naming conjecture.
The focus's singular installed deity can therefore be instantiated as a total explanatory regime, not only an object of ritual devotion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exclusive causal claim about time, no knowledge, and conjecture; I infer that this is one concrete enactment of installing inclination as ultimate authority. The live alternative is that 45:24 supplies a separate doctrinal error rather than an instance of the focus diagnosis.

changed_reading.before: The installed desire is chiefly a sensual urge or immediate preference.
changed_reading.after: The installed desire can be an intellectually satisfying but conjectural causal system, such as granting time exclusive agency over life and death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated question of what comes after God, purposeful subjection of creation, the contrast of rival patrons with divine protection, universal sovereignty, and final majesty all define deity as governance. Installing desire is therefore an unauthorized transfer of command, protection, and final explanatory authority; there is no peer guide waiting beyond the true source.

activation_trace.role: A newly circulating report supplies the proposed rival discourse whose authority is challenged.
What follows after a prior source supplies the same succession formula later applied to guidance in the focus.
Directing a thing toward a purpose supplies a concrete form of rightful governance.
Taking charge of an affair frames the contrast between wrongdoers' mutual governance and divine guardianship.
Universal sovereignty supplies the nontransferable governing domain against which desire's promotion is counterfeit.
Majesty and greatness close the context by locating ultimate elevation outside the self.
Self-acquisition supplies the unauthorized installation of a rival governor.
The worshipped office concentrates command, protection, and final allegiance in the focus contrast.

structural_cues: The formula after God appears in 45:6 for authoritative discourse and in 45:23 for guidance.
The sequence moves from creation directed for a purpose, through rival and divine patrons, to universal sovereignty and closing majesty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession formulas, purposeful subjection, patronage, sovereignty, and majesty; I group these as functions of governance transferred to desire in the focus. A live alternative is to restrict the focus deity language to worship while treating the political and protective functions as contextual parallels only.

changed_reading.before: Desire is called a deity as a strong metaphor for disobedience.
changed_reading.after: Desire is a counterfeit governor assigned command, protection, and explanatory priority inside a domain whose direction and sovereignty admit no peer after God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's opening summons to consider becomes a proleptic courtroom viewing: later the addressee sees communities kneeling, each is called to a written record, and the copied record gives its own indication. Covered personal sight and sealed inward reception cannot erase the external trace, so the final invitation to remember is a present chance to read the case before the record speaks.

activation_trace.role: Actual seeing by eye or insight supplies the future scene anticipated by the focus's opening summons.
Kneeling on the knees supplies the bodily courtroom posture of the case being shown.
An organized written record supplies evidence external to the person's sealed self-report.
A sign that speaks by its indication lets the record disclose truth without depending on the person's receptive faculties.
Copying one written form into another supplies preservation of acts beyond subjective memory.
The opening attention-and-report formula turns the focus person into a case presented for inspection now.
A reminder that restores presence supplies the present alternative to later confrontation by the record.

structural_cues: The focus begins with a seeing/considering formula; 45:28 begins with direct future seeing and immediately stages kneeling communities before their records.
45:29 makes the record an active truth-bearing witness and says ongoing acts were copied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching seeing formulas, a kneeling scene, summoned records, speaking indication, and copying; I infer that the focus opening previews a forensic case and that remembering is its present rehearsal. The alternative is a looser rhetorical recurrence without deliberate prolepsis.

changed_reading.before: The opening asks for detached observation of an individual moral failure.
changed_reading.after: The opening summons the reader to inspect a case before its courtroom replay: subjective faculties may close, but copied action becomes externally visible and evidentiary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The worldly surface deceives by a shine that does not endure, while the results of action remain covered; later those results emerge and surround the person. The reciprocal abandonment for having abandoned the encounter reverses the focus's final call to remember. The visual cover is therefore temporal and selective: it admits attractive surfaces now, hides consequences, and becomes an enclosing consequence later.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into visibility supplies the later disclosure of what the earlier cover withheld.
Harm descending and surrounding its target converts an inner obstruction into an outer enclosure.
Leaving something neglected supplies the reciprocal outcome opposed by the focus's final demand to remember.
Deception by a bright but unstable surface supplies what the covered sight is allowed to privilege.
Acquiring the signs for a mocking use repeats the focus mechanism of self-serving reassignment.
An overlying cover supplies the initial selective concealment that later reverses into exposure.
Active recollection supplies the remaining interruption to neglect before concealed results become present.

structural_cues: 45:33 sequences emergence and surrounding; 45:34 makes abandonment reciprocal; 45:35 names deceptive worldly appearance and repeats taking signs as ridicule.
The focus itself places cover before its final memory question, so concealment and recollection are adjacent alternatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive shine, later emergence, surrounding harm, reciprocal neglect, and the focus cover; I infer a temporal arrow from selective perception to externalized consequence. The live alternative is that the cover and later enclosure are separate punishments linked only thematically.

changed_reading.before: The cover is a static inability to see true propositions.
changed_reading.after: The cover is selective and temporal: it foregrounds attractive surfaces, hides acquired consequences, and is later reversed when those consequences appear and enclose the person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun is directly anchored in inward inclination, not literal falling or empty air. It remains worth carrying because the same root inventories supply void and downward fall, the focus immediately moves to deviation and direction, and nearby destruction and rescue branches sustain a spatial field. Render it only as a latent gravitational overlay, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The desire root at word 5 sits between self-installation and deviation, while the second half asks about restored direction.

activation_trace.role: Hollow air or an emptied interior supplies the loss of stable inner ground beneath the ruling inclination.
A fall toward an abyss supplies a gravitational vector hidden inside the desire root.
Leaving the intended road converts the downward pull into actual loss of course.
Direction and course supply the spatial counterforce to drift and fall.
A lethal abyss or trackless waste extends the focus's latent fall into the next ayah's claim about destruction.
A wilderness poised between rescue and ruin supplies the later counter-image of successful passage.

changed_reading.before: Desire is an internal preference that issues commands.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial overlay, desire is also a self-authorized gravitational field: it hollows stable judgment, pulls downward, and converts guidance into an attempted rescue from a course already falling away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus construction strongly favors a preventing seal, whereas the agricultural branch names a first watering after tillage. It remains anchored in the exact seal root and is unusually activated by the packet's descent-revival-water-access sequence. Render it as counter-pressure inside the image of closure: it may qualify finality, but it must not claim that the focus directly promises reopening.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The seal at word 10 is followed by the exclusive question of who could guide after God.

activation_trace.role: The first irrigation after tillage supplies a faint cultivation echo inside the same root used for closure.
Delivered descent supplies the water that initiates the surrounding cultivation sequence.
Rain-revived earth supplies transformation after an apparently dead condition.
A visible water access keeps the cultivation echo connected to the prescribed route before the focus.
Guidance from the uniquely competent source contains any possibility of revived direction within divine agency.

changed_reading.before: The seal is only a terminal mechanical closure.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing the preventive sense, the wider water network leaves a faint cultivation echo: even this closed condition lies inside a field where descent, revival, and renewed direction belong to God alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus forms ordinarily denote considering, hearing, and sight, not ostentation or reputation. It remains anchored because those are explicit branches of the focus roots and repeated self-magnification supplies a visible social mechanism. Render it as a social-psychological overlay: closed to divine signs yet highly responsive to being seen, heard about, and ranked by others.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse opens with seeing, seals hearing, covers sight, and places all three around the installation of desire as authority.

activation_trace.role: Acting to be seen by people supplies an alternative social gaze that can govern conduct.
Circulating reputation supplies the auditory social feedback paired with performance for observers.
Inclination supplies the selector that privileges approval-bearing signals over corrective signs.
Self-claimed greatness supplies the status motive for maintaining the social performance after hearing.
Repeated self-magnification confirms that the status response persists when the signs are recited again.
Mutual attachment and support supply the peer network within which reputation can govern.

changed_reading.before: The person is simply insensitive to every signal.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social overlay, the person is selectively sensitive: divine signs are blocked while peer visibility, circulating reputation, alliance, and status continue to steer desire.

strongest_changes: The seal changed from unexplained sensory deprivation into the stabilized result of audible reception, learned recognition, knotted persistence, and self-serving reassignment.
Knowledge changed from a single possession into a scope fork sharpened by post-knowledge rivalry, visible route-markers, accountable acquisition, and still-live divine knowledgeable judgment.
Desire changed from appetite into counterfeit governance, including a conjectural causal regime that grants extended time exclusive agency.
The opening demand to see changed into a present forensic preview of the later kneeling communities and their copied, truth-bearing records.
The cover changed from static blindness into selective temporal concealment that later reverses when acquired consequences appear and surround.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted abstract faculties into directional mechanisms: hearing became uptake, the heart became a pivot, knowledge became a route-marker, the prescribed course became water access, and sight became both present discernment and future evidence. These activations preserve a coherent accountability reading without erasing the unresolved scope of divine agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax does not finally decide whether knowledge primarily qualifies the person, the divine act, or both.
The watercourse model is strongly sequenced but remains a reader-supplied cross-domain integration rather than an explicit equation in the packet.
The gravitational, irrigation, and social-gaze readings are branch-backed latent overlays and should not be rendered as lexical replacements.
The context supports a progression from refusal to seal, but it does not expose a complete temporal causal chain for divine misdirection.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A hollow center closes the faculties around itself.** `ه و ي/B001` is void or hollowness, `ق ل ب/B001` the inward faculty, and `غ ش و/B001` a covering veil. The packet supplies desire installed as deity, followed by hearing, heart, and sight becoming closed or covered. I infer that enthroning a vacant appetite forces the perceptual system to exclude anything that could displace it. The ayah reads as self-sealing cognition organized around an empty center.
2. **A completed closure rather than missing information.** `خ ت م/B001` is reaching a final end and completing, while `ع ل م/B001` is disclosed knowledge. The striking proximity is misguidance "upon knowledge" followed by sealing. I infer that available disclosure has already been processed through chosen desire; more data alone cannot reopen the completed pattern. The final question about guidance marks a structural blockage, not an informational deficit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayat 45:24-25 immediately demonstrate the closed system: conjecture is called knowledge, and clear recitation is answered by an impossible evidentiary demand.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Deified desire becomes a gravity into vacancy.** Lexical anchors: taking/making for oneself in `ء خ ذ B010`, worshipped object in `ء ل ه B001`, inclination in `ه و ي B004`, void/hollowness in `ه و ي B001`, and falling into an abyss in `ه و ي B002`. The packet supplies the explicit path/desire contrast in 45:18 and conjectural life-accounting in 45:24. I infer desire enthroned -> direction generated by inclination alone -> downward loss of ground. The phrase diagnoses an alternative guidance mechanism, not simply excessive appetite.
2. **The perceptual system is sealed at successive interfaces.** Lexical anchors: securing/preventing seal in `خ ت م B003`, compliant understanding in `س م ع B003`, inward faculty and turning in `ق ل ب B001` and `ق ل ب B004`, inner sight in `ب ص ر B002`, and covering veil in `غ ش و B001`. The packet supplies `بَصَٰٓئِر` in 45:20 and clear recited signs in 45:25. I infer closure of hearing -> prevention of inward turning -> covered insight. Misguidance reads as a blocked processing chain despite available knowledge, not as scarcity of evidence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:24's conjectural causal claim and 45:25's encounter with clear signs confirmed that evidence remains available outside the sealed interfaces. The surprise was corrective: `عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ` need not make the blockage informational; it can coexist with a disabled route from hearing to inward turning and sight.

baseline.text: Arzusunu ilah edinen, Allah'ın bilerek saptırdığı, kulağını ve kalbini mühürlediği, gözünün üzerine perde koyduğu kişiyi gördün mü? Allah'tan sonra ona kim doğru yolu gösterebilir? Düşünmeyecek misiniz?

findings.text: İsteği ilah edinmek, eğilimi kendi başına yön üreten bir merkeze yerleştirir; bu merkez kişiyi sağlam zeminden boşluğa ve düşüşe çeken alternatif bir kılavuzluk düzenidir.
İşitme, içe dönüp değerlendirme ve iç görüş art arda kapatılmış bir işlem zincirine dönüşür; bilgi mevcut olsa da daha fazla veri tek başına tamamlanmış bu kapanmayı açamaz.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge presents a traversable route, while following, divergence, transgression, and desire determine where the traveler ends.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Law becomes a public watering approach, prophecy a clear road, disagreement a physical fork, and desire an empty medium that tips the follower into a fall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Law Opens as a Watering Route
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A clear road brings travelers to an open water source; entering it and following its traces sustains directed movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: public approach to water (`quranic:root_000789:B002/m01`); entering and undertaking an affair (`quranic:root_000789:B003/m01`); following a person, order, or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); tracing an imprint step by step (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); prophecy as a clear road (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); gentle guidance to a path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `شريعة` supplies the setting and access point, prophecy supplies the road, command supplies direction, and following supplies locomotion. The legal image is therefore a maintained approach to life-giving access rather than an abstract rule set.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Knowledge presents a traversable route, while following, divergence, transgression, and desire determine where the traveler ends.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Law becomes a public watering approach, prophecy a clear road, disagreement a physical fork, and desire an empty medium that tips the follower into a fall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Desire Pulls the Follower Into a Hollow Fall
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A follower substitutes inward inclination for guidance; the directing medium proves hollow and becomes a downward trajectory into loss of the path.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: appetite and inward inclination (`quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`); empty air and an unsteady heart (`quranic:root_001609:B001/m01`); falling into an abyss (`quranic:root_001609:B002/m01`); following another's course (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); straying from the intended road (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); gentle guidance to the path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Desire is both the chosen guide and an empty space incapable of bearing weight. Following it thus changes from horizontal imitation into vertical descent, sharpening the contrast between a supplied route and self-directed appetite.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Open Insight and the Sealed Sensorium (P2: 45:15-26)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Perception becomes guidance only when the bodily and inward instruments remain open; closure turns those same instruments into barriers.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Insight can function as defensive armor, while the denied sensorium resembles a sealed document whose openings have been stamped and overlaid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stamp, Seal, and Veil Close the Instruments
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hearing, heart, and sight are treated as apertures and surfaces that can be stamped, secured against access, and covered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: imprint of a stamp (`quranic:root_000393:B002/m01`); securing seal that prevents access (`quranic:root_000393:B003/m01`); auditory reception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); ear as the hearing aperture (`quranic:root_000741:B002/m01`); comprehension that should issue in obedience (`quranic:root_000741:B003/m01`); heart as organ of understanding (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); overlying veil (`quranic:root_001088:B001/m01`); visual perception (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); disappearance into hiddenness (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The seal supplies both an impressed mark and a fastening operation; the veil adds an outer layer. Hearing remains a component but loses its passage into obedient understanding, while sight and heart are likewise converted from channels into closed surfaces.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.

facets.statement: Görülebilir bir şeyi gözle veya benzer bir içsel kavrayışla algılama.
